s1.publisher: Bluewater Dive Travel (Scuba Lodge & Ocean Suites)
s1.quote: Lost Anchor A favorite Curacao Dive Site, bright and colorful. A beautiful lush wall covered with gorgonians and sea fans. Dense coral growth hides an anchor chain

s2.quote: Lost Anchor … it’s recommended that you go on a boat diving trip as it’s not great to reach from shore … a long anchor of at least 90 meters long, which is nowadays grown with coral and sponges

Very long anchor chain overgrown with coral and sponges

summary.text: Colorful wall covered in gorgonians and sea fans, best dived by boat. It is named for an anchor chain at least 90 m long that is now overgrown with coral and sponges.

s1.publisher: Bluewater Dive Travel (Scuba Lodge & Ocean Suites)
s1.quote: Plateau Gorgonians and hard corals, and everything in between. An excellent dive site to spot lobsters under the overhangs and crabs hiding in the large barrel sponges

s2.quote: which is a shallow plateau that continues into a coral-covered wall … can be reached both by boat or you can swim there from Jan Thielbaai

highlights.text: Lobsters under overhangs, crabs in barrel sponges
Gorgonians and hard corals on a wall below a shallow plateau

summary.text: Shallow plateau north of Jan Thiel that drops into a coral-covered wall rich in gorgonians, hard coral and barrel sponges, with lobsters and crabs. Reached by boat or by a swim from Jan Thiel Bay.

sites.name: Divers Leap

s2.publisher: Bluewater Dive Travel (Scuba Lodge & Ocean Suites)
s2.quote: Divers Leap At this dive site, you may have the possibility to do a great drift dive, flying while enjoying the reef scene in front of you

highlights.text: Possible drift dive along the reef

summary.text: House reef in front of Jan Thiel Beach with easy entry from a small beach; a short shallow stretch leads to a drop-off at about 10 m, and conditions sometimes allow a drift dive.

sites.depthNote: Most sea life at 8-15 m along the wall edge

summary.text: Quiet shore dive at a secluded west-coast beach in the San Juan area. Entry fee at the country house, no facilities, but healthy coral reefs with plenty of fish and the odd seahorse.

s1.quote: Kokomo Beach (Vaersen Bay) … You could also go to the car pile which is about 390 meters to the left and lie at about 35 meters

s2.quote: Kokomo Beach … There are many old car wrecks at a depth of about 30-50 meters … Plan enough air for the return trip on this dive

highlights.text: Field of old car wrecks, with a small wreck just beyond at 45 m

summary.text: Car pile off Kokomo Beach: many old car wrecks lying roughly 30-50 m deep, with a small wreck just beyond. A long surface swim and depth mean you must plan air carefully.

s1.quote: Good for: dive, snorkel, Beach, Shore Diving … Alice in Wonderland starts with a sandy bottom followed by the first drop-off at 8 meters … The reef, mainly consisting of fan-, leaf-, star- and brain coral

s2.quote: Alice in Wonderland, also known as Playa Kalki Reef, is a spectacular reef dive site starting at 5 meters and dropping down to over 30 meters

s3.quote: Playa Kalki (Alice in Wonderland) … Big corals are along a big wall for a true Curaçao dive experience

highlights.text: Fan, leaf, star and brain corals
Big corals along a wall

summary.text: Westpunt shore dive from the beach: a sandy start, first drop-off at about 8 m, then a coral wall sloping beyond 30 m. Fan, leaf, star and brain corals are the main draw.

s1.quote: Playa Piscado, also known as Playa Grandi … famous for its friendly sea turtles swimming close to the shore

s2.quote: Playa Piskado - Neptunes Reef … this easily accessible dive site offers a nice steep wall and a big opportunity to see turtles

highlights.text: Sea turtles near the fishermen's pier

summary.text: Fishermen's beach on the west coast where turtles gather near shore. Easily accessible shore dive with a steep wall and good chances of turtles.

s1.quote: Playa Jeremi is a lesser-known beach with pristine coral reefs and minimal crowds, offering a serene diving experience

highlights.text: Pristine coral reefs

s2.quote: areas where you can find quite a lot of car tires (Playa Forti) or fishing materials such as nets, fishing lines

hazards.text: Car tires and fishing line debris on the seabed

s1.quote: Watamula … Its pristine hard coral formations make this one of the top dive sites of the island … Occasionally strong currents make for a great drift dive

s2.quote: Watamula is one of the best dive boat locations in Curaçao, but also one that you should only visit with the help of a guide … There are three different currents here … Level: Experienced divers with a guide

highlights.text: Pristine hard coral field with barrel sponges
Cleaning stations

hazards.text: Several currents; dive with a guide

summary.text: Boat drift dive at the northwest tip of the island with pristine hard coral and big barrel sponges. Several meeting currents make it a site for experienced divers, ideally with a guide.

sites.name: Mushroom Forest & Blue Room

s1.quote: Mushroom Forest … Most life is found around the 40ft/12m to 50ft/14m mark where gigantic mountainous star coral formations are still evident and attract giant moray eels, porcupine fish, barracuda and lobster

s2.publisher: Bluewater Dive Travel (Scuba Lodge & Ocean Suites)
s2.quote: Mushroom Forest One of the most famous dive sites in Curacao. Over time hard coral formations have grown in such a way that they resemble mushrooms

s3.quote: Mushroom Forest … The location is only reachable by boat … Often this boat dive is combined with a visit to the blue room … You can snorkel into this cave

highlights.text: Mushroom-shaped hard coral formations
Giant moray eels, porcupinefish, barracuda and lobster

summary.text: Famous west-coast boat dive over mushroom-shaped hard corals, with most life at 12-14 m among large star corals. Often combined with the nearby Blue Room cave.

sites.depthNote: Most life at 12-14 m (40-50 ft) in Mushroom Forest

sites.name: Airplane Wreck (Santa Martha)

s1.quote: Santa Martha Bay (Sunset Waters) … It is easy to enter the water from the beach, passing between the two breakwaters … at depth of 7 meters are the remains of a light aircraft

sites.depthNote: Remains of a light aircraft at about 7 m

s1.quote: Klein Curaçao … The coral reef at Klein Curaçao is stunning and in fantastic shape … Some areas can have a pretty strong current, so it’s recommended to dive only when the weather is calm … Level: Experienced divers

s2.publisher: Bluewater Dive Travel (Scuba Lodge & Ocean Suites)
s2.quote: Klein Curacao A very special trip for divers only … They say that in Klein Curacao underwater everything is bigger and there is more of it

s3.quote: Klein Curaçao … It’s also beautiful for diving and there is a big chance of spotting turtles here

highlights.text: Stunning, healthy coral reef
Good chance of turtles

hazards.text: Strong current in places; dive in calm weather

summary.text: Uninhabited island about 10 km off the south coast, reached by boat day trip. The reef is in excellent condition with turtles, but some areas have strong current, so it suits experienced divers in calm weather.
